releases.body:
## Fixes

- **Projects below the git root.** OpenCode reports `snapshot.files` and `vcs.status` relative to the repository root, so in a project that is a subdirectory of the repository the touched files, the handoff file statuses and the anchor candidates offered to DREAM were wrong. They are now resolved against the worktree root and mapped to project-relative paths; files outside the project are dropped.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/cioffiAI/rem-memory/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.name: v2.0.0 — rem-memory
releases.body:
`@cioffi_ai/opencode-memory` continues as **rem-memory 2.0** (OpenCode V2 only).

## Highlights
- **Code-anchored memories**: project facts can point at `path#symbol`; state (fresh / drifted / broken) is derived on every read, broken anchors are not surfaced, `memory_inspect({ show: "stale" })`.
- **Session handoff**: a mechanical "where were we" note on session completion, enriched by DREAM at no extra model call, injected once on the next session's first request; new `memory_handoff` tool and `/memory resume`.
- **Built-in `/memory` command** (no manual copy); `command: false` to keep a custom one.
- **DREAM works on OpenCode's free tier**: internal generation moved from `generate.text` (rejected there) to `session.generate`, with system prompt and conversation stripped; tools are never executed.
- Host-neutral engine (`src/engine`) behind a `Host` interface, ready for other agents.

## Breaking
- Package renamed to `rem-memory`; OpenCode V1 adapter removed.
- `REM_MEMORY_*` env vars (`OPENCODE_MEMORY_*` still read with a deprecation warning).
- Default dir `~/.local/share/rem-memory`, one-time copy of the old store (old dir untouched).
- Store schema v3 (1.7.3 refuses it instead of reading it as empty).

See the upgrade guide in the README and CHANGELOG.md.

## Verification
- `bun run check`: 252 tests pass; retrieval benchmark (dev + held-out) byte-identical to 1.7.2.
- `verify:package` against the real OpenCode 2.0.18 CLI with a local mock model.
- End-to-end with the free `muse-spark-1.3` model: anchors fresh/drifted/broken, mechanical + DREAM-enriched handoff, first-request injection, `/memory resume` (11/11).

releases.name: v1.7.3 — final 1.x release
releases.body:
Final release of `@cioffi_ai/opencode-memory`. The package continues as [`rem-memory`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rem-memory) 2.0 (OpenCode V2 only); see the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/cioffiAI/rem-memory#upgrading-from-opencode-memory-1x).

## Fixes

- A store written by rem-memory 2.x (schema version 3 or later) is no longer read as an empty store, which let the next write overwrite every fact. 1.x now refuses to read or write it and reports an error instead.

Stay on 1.7.3 only if you still run OpenCode V1.

## Fixes

- **#11 — Parallel memory writes:** distinct explicit facts no longer overwrite one another because of similar wording. Jack's exact `Promise.all` example now preserves both preferences. Identical text still refreshes an entry; use `memory_update` by ID for corrections.
- Mutations queue across plugin instances sharing a directory, avoiding local lock-retry timeouts while retaining cross-process filesystem locking.

## Summary controls (#12)

- Set `summary: false` in plugin options or `OPENCODE_MEMORY_SUMMARY=0` to hide the stored summary from model context and `memory_read`, and prevent DREAM from generating or updating it.
- `memory_clear({ summaryOnly: true })` erases only the shared summary, retaining all facts. Do not combine it with `scope`.
- Disabling the summary preserves it on disk. If summary/DREAM remains enabled, a later consolidation can generate it again after clearing.

Both OpenCode V1 and V2 adapters support these changes.

## Verification

199 tests passed; 2 existing live-server tests skipped. Typecheck, build and clean packed-package checks passed for both adapters. Real OpenCode V2 2.0.18 checks passed with a local deterministic model, including Code Mode parallel writes, summary controls, DREAM, context injection, store migration and local-only privacy. Real V1 CLI coverage was unavailable; V1 adapter and isolated-package checks passed.

Install or update to `@cioffi_ai/opencode-memory@1.7.2` and restart OpenCode.

## What's new

- DREAM and SURFACE can be switched off independently while explicit memory tools remain available (#8).
- Every memory setting can be configured in `opencode.jsonc` for OpenCode V1 and V2. Plugin options take precedence over environment variables and are isolated per plugin instance (#9).
- Existing environment switches keep their 1.7.0 behavior.

## Verification

- 181 tests passed; typecheck and build passed.
- The npm tarball installed and exercised the V1 and V2 adapters in an isolated directory.
- OpenCode V2 2.0.18 passed live checks with automatic memory active and with DREAM/SURFACE disabled through `opencode.jsonc` using a local mock model.

OpenCode V1 was checked through the adapter and isolated package tests; a real V1 CLI was not available for this release.
